media.title: “With his foot, Mussolini is crushing the dove of peace”
media.creator: al-Musawwar (Egyptian weekly)
media.repository: Wikimedia Commons (scan of the al-Musawwar front page)
media.creditLine: al-Musawwar, 6 September 1935, front page. Public domain in Egypt; via Wikimedia Commons
media.altText: Cartoon: a huge, snarling Mussolini with clenched fists; his leg, drawn as the boot of Italy on a globe, crushes a dove.
